# Copilot Instructions for This Repository

The canonical, tool-neutral behavioral instructions for this repo live in
[`/AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Claude Code imports it via `CLAUDE.md`; Copilot-based assistants
should read it here.

**Read that file first** and follow it exactly. It is the single source of truth for how any AI
assistant should behave here -- directory map, type vocabulary, background behaviors, note-writing
rules, and the skill/agent trigger table. This stub exists only so Copilot-based assistants find
their way to it; do not duplicate the instructions here.

For Claude-specific behavior, see [`/CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md).
